name: Translation Feed
summary: Shows Hungarian titles and descriptions from a feed you publish.
description: Reads a JSON feed of translated titles and descriptions from a server you control and shows them on the detail page wherever the catalogue has no translation of its own. This displays text; it does not write to the catalogue — extensions run in the viewer's browser and have no database access, so importing into anime_translations is a server-side job and this is deliberately not that. Useful for trying a translation set out, or for a group that keeps its text somewhere other than the catalogue.

feed_url.description: A JSON feed keyed by AniList id. Must be on the host allowed in this extension's permissions.

refresh_minutes.description: How long to keep the feed before fetching it again.
